column1: # The client's BOOLEAN UniversalConfig keys - the complete set, recovered from the binary (#448).
# The getter is FUN_00A7E1F0(default), and a call site builds its key first with FUN_0040EC10(<literal>, <len>) -
# the shape FUN_00A7EBE0 uses for `IsDeveloperUniverse`. Walking every caller of the getter back to that literal
# enumerates the keys exhaustively: 21 call sites, 15 distinct keys, none unrecovered.
# These are settable with NO patch: the loader FUN_00A7CF90 merges SelfConfig.xml, UniversalConfig.xml and
# LocalConfig.xml (only the last ships in a retail install), self-context `Universe/Client/`, values `True`/`False`.
# ⚠️ This is the BOOL getter only. A key read through an int/string/float sibling would not appear here - but
# every name on #448's dev-lever backlog was checked by xref and NONE of them is a config key of any kind; see
# docs/subsystems/client-dev-levers.md for what each one turned out to be instead.
